title: Bound evidence wire alternatives before copy
finding: EvidenceValue.from_dict validated that alternatives was a sequence, then copied the full untrusted sequence into a tuple before EvidenceValue.__post_init__ applied MAX_EVIDENCE_ALTERNATIVES. The declared ceiling therefore did not bound decoder work or allocation at the wire boundary.
primary_claim: EvidenceValue.from_dict now reuses the existing _bounded_sequence helper before tuple materialization, so oversized wire alternatives fail closed by length without element access. Constructor-time canonicalization and inner-term bounds remain the single semantic path.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing bounded-sequence primitive instead of adding a decoder helper, codec layer, or separate evidence schema. The adversarial regression lives in the existing tensor evidence-bound test surface rather than a new test module.
acceptance: oversized EvidenceValue wire alternatives fail before any element access or tuple copy
the existing MAX_EVIDENCE_ALTERNATIVES limit remains the canonical outer evidence fan-out bound
normal EvidenceValue round trips and canonicalization remain unchanged
no new backend, persistence authority, semantic plane, OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert G1-TENSOR-01AQ; no Forest/Fourfold authority or persisted schema changes are involved.
